notes.title: New Patch Released v1.10 (Dec. 01, 2017)
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/8686853/cd42eb51a7a941cab7a392f096e27ff8e6e392f7.png[/img]

We've just released a new patch for Nightfall: Escape today! 

* Removed the driving scene
* Fixed the mouse problem
* Fixed the blur scene
* Updated ending situation based on user decision
* Linux build is already working

An important milestone to fix some bugs, issues and concerns.

Feel free to contact us.

notes.title: Patch #6 Released (Alpha 1.0.8)
notes.content:
It's been more than 1 month since our last update, and today we release significant updates for Alpha 1 of Nightfall. 

It includes: 

- UI and texture improvements 
- Fixed some malfunction on shaders
- Additional in-game help
- Saving improvements
- Added more SFX 
- Lots of small bug fixes and improvements 


Enjoy!

It includes: 

- Expanded maps
- Exciting story 
- UI and texture improvements 
- Specular maps implemented 
- Saving system upgrade 
- Added more SFX 
- Additional brightness adjustment 
- Lots of small bug fixes and improvements 


Enjoy!
